name: Pre-Boss
description: The very start of a fresh Calamity world, gathering basic ores and gearing up before the first boss.
cues: Wooden/ore-tier gear and a fresh world
No boss has been defeated yet
Exploring surface and shallow caves for copper/tin through gold/platinum
guideNote: Start as you normally would - build a couple of houses and increase your maximum health and mana. If you have a Gravitation Potion, search for floating islands and Planetoids.

name: Pre-Evil Boss
triggeredBy: Before Eater of Worlds / Brain of Cthulhu
description: Preparing to fight the first Calamity boss, the Desert Scourge, and readying for the evil-biome bosses.
cues: Desert Scourge available at the Ocean or Desert
Fishing up gear and building basic arenas
Early Calamity ores like Aerialite becoming accessible
guideNote: Defeating your first bosses vastly expands your options: After the Eye of Cthulhu is defeated, you should explore the Underground Jungle, fight the Blood Moon and Goblin Army, and challenge the newly unlocked Acid Rain event. Defeating the Desert Scourge unlocks the Giant Clam miniboss and is the point where you should explore the Sunken Sea.

name: Pre-Hive Mind / Perforators
triggeredBy: Before The Hive Mind / The Perforators
description: Heading into the Corruption or Crimson to take on the Hive Mind or Perforators before Skeletron.
cues: Hive Mind (Corruption) or Perforators (Crimson) not yet beaten
Using post-Desert-Scourge gear (Victide, Aerialite)
Building an evil-biome arena
guideNote: At this point, you've already defeated a few bosses - including Brain of Cthulhu or Eater of Worlds - and should be getting ready for a trip to The Underworld. Meteorite is now available.

name: Pre-Skeletron
description: Post-evil-boss, working toward the Slime God and Skeletron to unlock the Dungeon.
cues: Slime God fight now available
Aerospec/mollusk-tier armor equipped
Skeletron not yet defeated, Dungeon still guarded
guideNote: After defeating The Hive Mind or The Perforators, you can now mine Aerialite, found in Floating Islands. Queen Bee and Deerclops can be fought to obtain equipment for Skeletron.

name: Pre-Wall of Flesh
description: Late pre-Hardmode, clearing the Dungeon and prepping to kill the Wall of Flesh to enter Hardmode.
cues: Dungeon accessible after Skeletron
Wall of Flesh not yet beaten
Farming for a Guide Voodoo Doll in the Underworld
guideNote: With Skeletron defeated, you should explore the dungeon then head to the Abyss and loot its newly unlocked Ancient Treasure Chests. Down in the Underworld, Shadow Chests can now be opened, and you should now explore the Brimstone Crags.

name: Pre-Mechanical Bosses
description: Early Hardmode, fighting the Cryogen and Aquatic Scourge while building toward the mechanical bosses.
cues: Hardmode active, new ores (Cobalt/Palladium) spawned
Cryogen and Aquatic Scourge available
No mechanical boss defeated yet
guideNote: Entering Hardmode greatly expands the potential equipment options for every class. Life Fruits become available immediately, and you can craft a Comet Shard to increase your maximum mana.

name: Post-Mechanical Boss 1
description: One of the three mechanical bosses is down, opening up mid-Hardmode gear and the Brimstone Crag.
cues: First mech boss (Destroyer/Twins/Skeletron Prime) defeated
Hallowed Bars now farmable
Brimstone Elemental accessible in the Brimstone Crag
guideNote: After defeating your first Mechanical Boss, you will have access to the second tier of Hardmode Ore and the Hardmode Anvils. You will also be able to mine Infernal Suevite at the Brimstone Crag.

name: Post-Mechanical Boss 2
description: Multiple mechanical bosses cleared, pushing toward Calamitas Clone and Plantera.
cues: Two or more mech bosses beaten
Calamitas Clone fight available
Gathering mid-Hardmode Calamity materials
guideNote: With your second Mechanical Boss defeated, you should now have access to the third tier of Hardmode Ore. You can now mine Cryonic Ore in the Ice biome if you have defeated Cryogen.

name: Pre-Plantera
description: All mechs defeated, taking on Plantera and Calamity's Great Sand Shark and Leviathan.
cues: All three mechanical bosses down
Plantera bulbs spawning in the Underground Jungle
Leviathan and Anahita available at the Ocean
guideNote: After killing the final Mechanical Bosses, you now have access to Hallowed Bars and Chlorophyte Bars. If you find yourself short on Hallowed Bars, Hallowed Ore will also have generated in the Underground Hallow.

name: Pre-Golem
description: Post-Plantera, running the Temple and Jungle content and fighting Astrum Aureus toward Golem.
cues: Jungle Temple unlocked after Plantera
Astrum Aureus available at night
Golem not yet summoned in the Temple
guideNote: With Plantera defeated, Perennial Ore spawns. Enemies in the Dungeon become much stronger and begin dropping Ectoplasm.

name: Post-Golem
description: Golem defeated, unlocking the Plaguebringer Goliath and the Astral biome push toward the Lunar Events.
cues: Golem beaten, lihzahrd content cleared
Plaguebringer Goliath available
Preparing for the Lunatic Cultist
guideNote: Defeating Golem gives you access to Scoria Ore in the third layer of the Abyss, and Plague enemies will begin spawning in the Jungle. Make sure to consume a Miracle Fruit to increase your maximum HP.

name: Pre-Lunar Events
description: Approaching the Lunatic Cultist and the Lunar Events, fighting the Ravager and Astrum Deus.
cues: Ravager and Astrum Deus available
Lunatic Cultist spawns at the Dungeon entrance
Lunar Pillars not yet cleared
guideNote: Using the new equipment from the previously mentioned events and environments, you should take on some of the more difficult Hardmode bosses: the Plaguebringer Goliath, the Empress of Light, Duke Fishron, and Ravager. Their drops will prepare you for your penultimate challenges, the Lunatic Cultist and the Lunar Events.

name: Pre-Moon Lord
description: Lunar Pillars are being cleared to summon and defeat the Moon Lord, the last vanilla boss.
cues: Four Lunar Pillars active from the Cultist
Luminite and fragment gear being crafted
Moon Lord not yet defeated
guideNote: With the Lunatic Cultist defeated, you now have the Ancient Manipulator. After defeating a couple of the pillars and crafting new gear with Meld Constructs and Lunar Fragments, you can take on your second-to-last Hardmode boss: Astrum Deus, who unlocks Astral Bars.

name: Pre-Providence
triggeredBy: After the Moon Lord, before Providence
description: Post-Moon Lord, entering Calamity's true endgame and preparing for Providence in the Hallow or Underworld.
cues: Moon Lord defeated, Auric/early post-ML gear
Profaned Guardians beaten to unlock Providence
Providence, the Profaned Goddess not yet killed
guideNote: The story of Calamity continues after defeating the Moon Lord. You can now craft new gear using Luminite Bars and Lunar Fragments.

name: Pre-Polterghast
description: Providence is down, unlocking Post-Providence bosses like the Storm Weaver and Ceaseless Void before Polterghast.
cues: Providence defeated
Storm Weaver and Ceaseless Void (Sentinels) available
Polterghast not yet summoned in the Dungeon
guideNote: Defeating Providence gives you access to new crafting materials: Divine Geodes and Uelibloom Ore, which allow you to craft Tarragon armor and stronger weapons. The Tainted Cloudberry can now be crafted to increase your maximum HP.

name: Pre-Devourer of Gods
description: Polterghast beaten, opening the Sunken Sea/Abyss content and the Old Duke, heading toward the Devourer of Gods.
cues: Polterghast defeated
The Old Duke available via the Acid Rain event
Devourer of Gods not yet beaten
guideNote: Polterghast 's defeat gives you Ruinous Souls, allowing you to craft Bloodflare armor and more gear. The Phantom Heart, the final mana upgrade, is now available.

name: Pre-Yharon
description: Post-Devourer of Gods, wielding cosmilite/endgame gear and preparing for Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth.
cues: Devourer of Gods defeated, Cosmilite Bars farmable
Jungle Dragon Yharon summonable in the Jungle
Working toward Auric Tesla / god-tier gear
guideNote: Slaying The Devourer of Gods grants you Cosmilite Bars. Three new crafting materials are now available from buffed enemies: Darksun Fragments from the Solar Eclipse, Endothermic Energy from the Frost Moon, and Nightmare Fuel from the Pumpkin Moon.

name: Pre-Exo Mechs / Supreme Calamitas
triggeredBy: Before the Exo Mechs / Supreme Calamitas
description: Yharon is down, facing the final challenge bosses: the Exo Mechs and Supreme Calamitas.
cues: Yharon defeated
Draedon's Exo Mechs available at the Codebreaker
Supreme Calamitas not yet beaten
guideNote: Defeating Yharon causes Auric Ore to generate underground. Combining them with the Yharon Soul Fragments dropped by the boss allows you to craft Auric Tesla armor and powerful Auric weapons.

name: Endgame
description: All Calamity bosses including the Exo Mechs and Supreme Calamitas are defeated, with the strongest gear in the game.
cues: Exo Mechs and Supreme Calamitas beaten
Wielding the best endgame weapons and armor
Only superbosses/optional challenges remain
guideNote: Defeating the Exo Mechs and Supreme Witch, Calamitas allows you to combine Exo Prisms, Ashes of Annihilation, and Auric Bars into Shadowspec Bars. These are used to craft Demonshade armor and the developer items.
